name: 02465 · West Newton, MA
findings: ZIP 02465 (West Newton) has 78 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02465 (West Newton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02465 (West Newton) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).
